text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 - autoscaler unable to provision GPUs in gcp-asia-south2. Queue growth observed on inference-service-prod. High error rate for queued requests. Root TS: 1767777777. Paging on-call. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/1767777777 :rotating_light:

julia_oncall: oncall julia here, ack. I'm pulling pod status + autoscaler logs.

ash_infra: checking region quotas now. preliminary: GPUs appear fully used.

infra-bot: gce quota check for region asia-south2 requested by ash_infra

ash_infra: output:
```
$ gcloud compute regions describe asia-south2 --format=json
{
  "quotas": [
    {"metric":"GPUS_ALL_REGIONS","limit":24,"usage":24},
    {"metric":"CPUS","limit":500,"usage":312}
  ]
}
```

ryan_eng: autoscaler logs show repeated create failures: `failedInstanceCreation: quotaExceeded`. snippet:
```
I0301 12:14:02 autoscaler.go:123] scaleAttempt: +8 nodes requested
E0301 12:14:04 cloudprovider.go:54] CreateInstanceGroup: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded., quotaExceeded
```

pm_raju: customer impact? any tenants affected?

lexi_support: support reports elevated 5xx for enterprise tenants. AcmeCorp reported 503s starting ~12:12 UTC. Metrics: 10m window, 21% error rate on generation endpoints.

julia_oncall: impact confirmed: production inference queues backing up, latency spiking >10s P95, some requests dropped with 503. Not global - concentrated in apac (asia-south2). Lower-priority batches queued, causing head-of-line blocking for hosted API.

ash_infra: attempted to spin preemptible GPUs, also blocked by region quota. Manual check shows all GPU quota consumed by warm pools + reserved dedicated instances.

ryan_eng: quick mitigation options: 1) failover traffic for apac -> ap-southeast1 2) evict best-effort jobs from warm pools 3) temporarily reduce batch sizes/disable large-batch inference 4) enable cpu-fallback workers for stateless requests. I'll start 3 & 4 immediately.

ash_infra: opening support case with GCP. Submitted urgent quota increase (case: 987654321). ETA from GCP is unknown but requested accelerate. Also creating internal ticket for capacity reconciliation.

ash_infra: GCP case text (sent):
```
Subject: Urgent GPU quota increase request - asia-south2 - production outage
Hello, we are a production service experiencing quotaExceeded when provisioning GPUs in asia-south2. Current GPUS_ALL_REGIONS limit: 24, usage: 24. Requesting emergency increase to 72 to restore capacity for customer-facing workloads. Incident ref: 1767777777.
```

julia_oncall: doing routing change to divert new sessions away from asia-south2. @infra-bot please apply traffic policy: prefer ap-southeast1 for apac until further notice.

infra-bot: applying routing override: prefer-region=ap-southeast1 for inference-service-prod. Note: this is soft-failover; some sticky sessions may still hit asia-south2.

lexi_support: posted customer alert to status.redwood.ai: "APAC inference capacity degraded, some requests may see increased latency or errors. We are mitigating."

ryan_eng: reducing batch size on live model pools and toggling quantized model snapshot for latency-sensitive traffic. Commands run:
```
# reduce batching config on vhost
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/configs/batching -d '{"max_batch":8}'
```

julia_oncall: eviction in progress for best-effort warm pools (jobs id range: wf-*). This should free ~6 GPUs within 3-5 minutes. Monitoring pods/pending.

ash_infra: manual scale down of dedicated warm-pool completed, freed 4 GPUs. Current reported usage: 24/24 -> 20/24.

ryan_eng: good, autoscaler attempted another scale and provisioned smaller instances CPU-only to handle control-plane tasks. But GPU-backed replicas still pending.

lexi_support: customer update sent to impacted tenants (AcmeCorp + BetaStart). Response: acknowledging, asking for ETA.

pm_raju: prep message for enterprise customers: we should commit to timeline for mitigation and follow-up.

julia_oncall: breaking updates:
- 12:12 UTC incident detected (autoscale failures)
- 12:17 UTC pager fired -> oncall ack
- 12:20 UTC routing override applied to prefer ap-southeast1
- 12:26 UTC best-effort eviction + warm-pool scale down -> freed GPUs
- 12:28 UTC partial mitigation: decreased errors from 21% -> 6% in apac; global P95 down but not normal

ash_infra: GCP replied to urgent case: "We see your request, expedite flag acknowledged. Typical resolution 2-6 hours for capacity increases. For immediate relief, consider cross-region failover."

ryan_eng: proposed follow-ups after stabilization: 1) add proactive quota headroom check to autoscaler decision path 2) improve warm-pool tagging to avoid blocking production 3) run purple team test to ensure routing failover can shift 80% traffic.

julia_oncall: handing off to day team. @ryan_eng please take ownership for remediation and customer follow-ups. I'll draft a post-incident ticket and start the postmortem doc. Postmortem owner: julia_oncall.

ryan_eng: taking handoff, continuing: I'll keep routing override until we have confirmed sustained capacity and GCP quota increase. Creating jira RED-INC-3421 for follow-ups.

infra-bot: incident status update: PARTIALLY_MITIGATED - queued requests reduced; some residual 503s remain. Next update scheduled in 30m.

julia_oncall: notes for postmortem - owners assigned, include timeline, root cause (quota exhaustion due to insufficient headroom + warm-pool reservation), mitigation steps, and recommended changes.

lexi_support: keeping status page updated and queueing outbound emails to impacted customers.

pm_raju: thanks all. After action items: prioritize quota headroom + autoscaler guardrail in next sprint.

ryan_eng: will follow up with exact customer impact numbers and schedule a sync with infra to unblock any reserved pools. Handoff complete.

incident-bot: Incident 1767777777 recorded. Severity: P1 -> status: partial mitigation. Transcript saved to internal incident tracker.
